Applicant :- Smt. Shreti Prabha
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Shashank Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.
2. By means of this application, the only prayer made by the applicant is that a direction be issued to the court below concerned to decide the Criminal Case No. 05 of 2023 (State of U.P. Vs. Jaswant and Others) arising out of Case Crime/F.I.R. No. 436 of 2022,under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 406 I.P.C., Police Station.- Sasani Gate, District- Aligarh, within a short stipulated period.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is wife of the respondent no.2.
The applicant has filed a case under Sections 323, 498A, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act against respondent no.2.

He further submits that earlier, the respondent no.2 has approached before this Court in Criminal Misc. Application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. No.41008 of 2024 (Jaswant and 4 others Vs. State of U.P. and another, the this Court vide order dated 02.12.2024 has referred the case before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court directing the respondent no.2 to deposit Rs.40,000/- in favour of the applicant, thereafter, respondent no.2 has not complied with the order dated 02.12.2024, thereafter, on 10.01.2024, N.B.W. was issued against the respondent no.2.

entities.text: Jaswant and 4 others Vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that the respondent no.2 is deliberately not appearing before the court below.

4. Considering the facts of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the applicant's case, this application U/s 529 B.N.S.S. is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below concerned to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties as expeditiously as possible, if there is no legal impediment.
